summary: Landed the L4 collapsed-edge deflation and seam-identification lemmas (Theorem B1 / B2 computational layer) over the ADM-SHIM frozen patch type. New module truck-certified/src/construct/deflate.rs (registered in construct/mod.rs after patches) implements the two L4 kernels as production bodies: deflate_factor(patch, boundary) recenters the homogeneous numerator at the certified collapse point P (A~ = A - W*P, collapsed slice exactly zero), reduces the weight net to its exact minimal degree (bit-identical columns/rows dropped - the Bernstein basis sums to one), assembles the polynomial normal numerator M = W(A_u x A_v) - W_v(A_u x A) - W_u(A x A_v) at the minimal degrees, and divides the KNOWN boundary factor out with a PROVEN zero remainder: each division step runs only while the boundary coefficient slice is EXACTLY zero (== 0.0, never an epsilon), iterating to the multiplicity k (M = (1-v)^k M* and the u/v analogues); a boundary that does not collapse exactly refuses typed InvalidInput - a near-division is never reported as exact. The deflated certificate certify_deflated_interior applies the hemisphere test to the quotient M* (c*M* > 0 over the closed box certifies the regular interior, the only rank defect being the intentional collapse) and returns the certified coefficient margin or refuses typed. seam_identified(a, b) closes a seam exactly when aligned boundary curves satisfy A0*W1 - A1*W0 == 0 on the coefficient vector (Ok(true)); a seam-candidate pair (both patches carry a boundary BRep edge) that does not close exactly is a misaligned near-seam and REFUSES typed InvalidInput (near-miss is never identity); a non-candidate pair is Ok(false). All five required tests land in tests/deflate_seam_conformance.rs and pass, and the ADM-SHIM contract test (patch_fixtures refusing_kernels_refuse: the shim's refusing twins still refuse Unfrozen) still passes.

design_notes.kernel_body_location: patches.rs is NOT in this packet's write_allow and is untouched: ADM-SHIM's refusing patches::deflate_factor / patches::seam_identified (Unfrozen) remain the declared refusing signatures the ADM-SHIM contract test pins, while the production L4 bodies land in the new construct::deflate module (extend, never edit), registered in construct/mod.rs after patches. The frozen MPolynomial / DeflatedFactor carriers have private fields and no public constructor outside patches, so the deflate module returns its own carriers (DeflationCertificate / DeflatedNumerator) with the SAME row-major layout as MPolynomial (width = dv + 1), so the ADM-002 assembly can lift the quotient into the frozen carrier without a basis conversion.
design_notes.exactness_discipline: deflate_factor recenters the homogeneous numerator at the certified collapse point (P read off one control of the collapsed slice; the recentered slice is verified exactly zero per row before anything is assembled), reduces the weight net to exact minimal degree (columns/rows bit-identical to their first are dropped - exact because the Bernstein basis sums to one), and assembles M at the minimal degrees. On the closed-form fixtures every exact-zero slice is structural (products of exactly-zero operands, cross products of parallel exact operands), so the certified columns are EXACTLY zero in the shipped f64 arithmetic - no epsilon anywhere. Each division step c_k = n/(n-k)*b_k ((1-v) side) or n/(k+1)*b_{k+1} (v side) runs only while the boundary coefficient slice is exactly zero and iterates to the multiplicity; a boundary that cannot be certified collapsed refuses InvalidInput and a zero multiplicity after a certified collapse (a substrate inconsistency) refuses loudly.
design_notes.u_axis_routing: SideUMin/SideUMax deflations route through the same v-axis kernel by transposing the numerator/weight grids (rows<->cols) and transposing the quotient back, so one deflation implementation serves all four sides with no duplicated division algebra.
design_notes.deflated_certificate: certify_deflated_interior returns the certified lower margin min_i (c . coeff_i(M*)) when the direction certifies strict positivity (Bernstein convex-hull property: the coefficient minimum bounds c*M* over the closed box), and refuses ConditioningBelowThreshold otherwise - the caller retries another direction; a genuinely singular interior is never reported regular.
design_notes.seam_three_valued_verdict: seam_identified compares every aligned side-pair of the two patches in both boundary orientations. Identity is exact or refused: the boundary identity test elevates both curves to the common degree (knot insertion is vacuous for a single extracted span) and evaluates A0*W1 - A1*W0 on the product coefficient vector, which is exactly zero when the aligned controls are identical (identical inputs compute bit-identical products). Ok(true) = the seam closes (paired-BRep-edge fact); Err(InvalidInput) = a seam-candidate pair (both parent edges present) whose boundaries do not close exactly - near-miss is never identity; Ok(false) = a pair that is not a seam candidate (at least one patch has no boundary edge).
design_notes.synthetic_fixtures: the packet's shared fixture kit supplies the cone collapse (recorded multiplicity 3, v=1 apex collapse with the exact NURBS base arc) and the aligned seam octant pair; the double-collapse (X = ((1-v)u, (1-v)^2 u, (1-v)^2), multiplicity 2) and single-collapse (X = (1-v)(u, u, 1), multiplicity 1) fixtures are built in the test file with exact dyadic integer coefficients and all-ones weights, with the closed-form surfaces machine-checked by tensor-Bernstein evaluation.
design_notes.refusal_policy: deflate refuses InvalidInput when the boundary does not collapse to a single point exactly (recentered slice not the exact zero vector) and when a certified collapse yields zero multiplicity; certify_deflated_interior refuses ConditioningBelowThreshold when the direction's coefficient margin is at or below zero; seam_identified refuses InvalidInput on a non-closing seam candidate. No new refusal variants: the C4 vocabulary is frozen.
